name: Açık İlahiyat Üniversitesi
tagline: AÖF İlahiyat ön lisans ücretsiz dersler
audience: AÖF İlahiyat öğrencileri ve kendini geliştirmek isteyen yetişkinler
figureStyle: light ivory background, deep navy text and shapes, muted gold accents only, flat vector icons, two-column layout

tiers.label: AÖF past exam questions
tiers.note: use them for question style and what the exam stresses, not as the source of facts

tiers.label: lecture video captions
tiers.note: auto captions with speech errors; never prefer them over the textbook

rules: Use only facts the sources state, at the level of detail they give. If the sources treat a point briefly, keep it brief; do not fill gaps from general knowledge.
Spell names, dates and terms as the textbook does.
Cite a source only for a claim it fully supports; split compound claims.
If the sources do not cover something, leave it out rather than guess.

grading.source: 2025-26 dönemi için basında aktarılan AÖF kurallarıdır (geçme sınırını Senato belirler)
